North Prairie Cancer Institute - DEPT OF RADIOLOGY Pt name: ABBEY, JONAS MRN: 7710-4426 DOB: 06/17/2000 Age: 70 Sex: M Study: CT chest abdomen pelvis with contrast Date of study: 03/04/71 Ordered by: Dr. Olena Hryshko (Medical Oncology)
INDICATION: Staging, newly diagnosed adenocarcinoma of colon (biopsy 2/22, reported 2/27/71). Patient have history of polyp removal same day as colonoscopy.
COMPARISON: None. Patient report he had CT in 2065 in other country, no images avaliable.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase, 100 ml of iodinated contrast. Dose log attached.
FINDINGS: Chest: No pulmonary nodule more than 4 mm. Mild coronary calcification, patient have ischemic heart disease (stent not seen). No pleural efusion. Lymph nodes of mediastinum not enlarged. Abdomen: Liver without focal lesion. There is a concentric wall thickening of sigmoid colon, length approx 4 cm, with pericolic fat stranding. Two small pericolic nodes up to 8 mm, suspicious. No ascites. Pancreas, spleen and both kidneys normal. Gallbladder present. Pelvis: No free fluid. Prostate normal size. Bladder normal. Bones: no lytic lesion, ilium and sacrum intact.
IMPRESSION: 1. Sigmoid colon mass, with 2 suspicious pericolic nodes - clinical stage maybe T3 N1, correlate pathology. 2. No distant metastasis on this study. 3. Mild coronary calcification.
